notes.title: DEMO IS ACTIVE
notes.content: [h1][b]Welcome to Space Restaurant Demo![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/6f35fdb8c071ab6cb7dd81c0a3e48c0178fc68ba.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Welcome, and thank you for playing![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]As development is still ongoing, current content, performance, and mechanics do not fully represent the final product.[/p][p][/p][p]We are continuously working to improve the game and release regular updates. You can expect frequent enhancements, and we will keep you informed about progress and upcoming changes here, so you and your fellow players can stay up to date.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We truly appreciate your support and interest in our game![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Please note:[/i][/b][i] Multiplayer is currently in its alpha stage. For the best experience, we recommend playing in Single-player mode at this time.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
